Initial release — convert still images into animated anime video clips via a cloud AI pipeline.

- Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP, and BMP files up to 200MB, returning 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic token setup for new and returning users.
- Handles uploads, edits (including BGM or text overlays), timeline previews, export/download, and credit checks.
- Error handling covers most common upload/render issues.
- Designed for anime artists and fans to turn static illustrations into animated video easily.
